About

With over 28 years of experience, 1 Day Kitchen & Bath is the #1 source of kitchen or bathroom remodeling.  We offer over 200 colors of quartz, granite, marble, and limestone to choose from as well as a wide selection of both RTA cabinetry and custom cabinets. We offer excellent low prices on Quartz, Granite, Marble, Tile, Installation and Fabrication. Specializing in custom home installations both new and remodels. We offer our experience in design, material selection, and installation expertise to help you achieve the ultimate style in your home interior surfaces. So from your pool to your kitchen countertops we can offer you stone solutions to fit your many needs.

We have complete control over every phase of the process so our prices are very competitive.  Please visit our Portfolio and other pages for samples of some of our previous work.  Call or email us to get an free estimate.   Visit our new showroom in Los Angeles, CA (By Appointment Only).   We are also able to complete kitchen or bathrooms countertops in just 1 or 2 days.

QUICK ANSWERS

Cost, timeline, financing - answered.

The questions we get on almost every discovery call, with numbers, before you spend an hour on the phone.

How much does it cost to remodel in the greater Seattle area?

As a rule of thumb in the greater PNW: kitchens $45k - $95k for a pull-and-replace, $95k - $180k for a full gut. Bathrooms $12k - $22k for a half-bath, $22k - $45k for a hall/guest, $45k - $90k for a primary/en-suite. Whole-home cosmetic refreshes $60k - $150k; full interior renovations $180k - $450k. Every Advanced Remodeling quote is a written, fixed-price, line-item estimate.

Are you licensed and insured in Washington?

Yes. Advanced Remodeling LLC is a licensed WA general contractor - registration ADVANRL813RC - bonded and carrying $2 million liability insurance. We pull permits and coordinate inspections on every project that requires them.

How long does a remodel take?

Bathrooms: 3 - 6 weeks on site. Kitchens: 6 - 10 weeks on site. Whole-home cosmetic refreshes: 4 - 8 weeks. Full interior renovations: 12 - 20 weeks. Additions and ADUs: 5 - 8 months including design and permitting.

Do you offer financing?

Yes - remodel financing is available OAC (on approved credit) through our lending partners. Rates and terms depend on your credit profile and project size. Ask for a pre-qual during your free onsite consultation.

What areas do you serve?

We serve the greater Puget Sound / PNW area: Seattle, Bellevue, Kirkland, Redmond, Bothell, Mill Creek, Mukilteo, Everett, Lynnwood, Edmonds, Shoreline, Mountlake Terrace, and surrounding cities. Based in Mountlake Terrace, WA (98043).

How do I get started?

Book a free onsite consultation - no cost, no obligation. We walk your home, understand your vision, and put a written line-item scope and fixed-price estimate together before any work begins. Most projects are scheduled within 3 - 5 business days of contract signing.

AUTHORITY GUIDE · WHOLE-HOME & INTERIOR REMODELS

A whole-home remodel is a general-contractor problem, not a specialist one. Every Advanced Remodeling whole-home project runs under a single fixed-price contract, one project manager, and one warranty - kitchen, baths, floors, paint, siding, or an addition, we coordinate every trade in-house.

One team, one timeline, one contract

The failure mode on whole-home remodels is homeowners hiring 5 separate trades and playing dispatcher. We run every trade under our WA general contractor registration (ADVANRL813RC), on one signed contract, with weekly written updates. If something goes wrong, there's one number to call.

Planning and permits

Multi-room remodels almost always trigger permits - mechanical for HVAC changes, plumbing for kitchen/bath, electrical for panel upgrades, and building for any structural work. We handle drawings, submittal, inspections, and final sign-off. Additions and ADUs also require planning review and sometimes engineered drawings; we coordinate that upfront.

Live in or move out?

For a kitchen + one bath, most homeowners live in. For a full-floor remodel or anything with structural work, moving out for 3 - 8 weeks saves your sanity and shaves days off the schedule. We can zone the house with plastic and negative-air machines when you stay - and honestly tell you when moving out is the right call.

Additions, basements, and ADUs

Adding square footage is the highest-ROI move in a PNW market where lots are constrained. We build room additions, second-story pops, finished basements with egress, garage conversions, and detached ADUs. Every scope carries the same fixed-price contract and workmanship warranty as our finish work.

Straight answers before you call

The questions we get most often on discovery calls - answered in plain English, with numbers, before you spend an hour on the phone.

How much does a whole-home remodel cost in Washington?

Whole-home cosmetic refreshes (paint, floors, trim, lighting, minor kitchen/bath updates) typically run $60,000 - $150,000. Full interior renovations touching kitchens, baths, flooring, and finishes across every room usually land $180,000 - $450,000. Additions and structural changes are quoted separately after a design consult.

How long does a full-home remodel take?

Cosmetic whole-home refreshes: 4 - 8 weeks. Full interior renovations: 12 - 20 weeks. Additions and ADUs: 5 - 8 months including design and permitting. Every project runs on a written schedule with weekly homeowner check-ins.

Should I move out during a whole-home remodel?

For gut-level renovations touching kitchens, primary bath, and HVAC - yes, usually 6 - 12 weeks. For phased or single-floor projects we can stage the work so you stay in the home. We plan the phasing at estimate time so there are no surprises.

Can you do additions and ADUs?

Yes. As a licensed WA general contractor we handle room additions, bump-outs, second-story additions, garage conversions, and detached/attached ADUs (DADU/AADU) from design and permitting through final inspection.

ELECTRICAL · LIGHT FIXTURES

Can a remodel install a light fixture in Washington State?

In Washington, only licensed electrical contractors and certified electricians may perform electrical work for hire - including swapping a light fixture. A remodel without an electrical specialty license legally cannot. Advanced Remodeling coordinates a licensed electrician for any hardwired work.

PLUMBING · LEAKS & WATER DAMAGE

How do I find a hidden water leak in my house?

Turn off every fixture and appliance, then watch the small red "leak indicator" dial on your water meter for 10 - 15 minutes. If it moves, you have flow somewhere with everything off - that's a leak. Isolate by shutting off the main to the house and the water heater; the meter tells you if it's on the incoming side or inside.

DOORS & WINDOWS · LOCKS & HARDWARE

How do I fix a door that won't latch properly?

A door that won't latch either has a strike plate that's out of alignment (most common) or the door itself has sagged. Close the door slowly and mark where the latch hits the strike - if it's above or below the hole, either move the strike plate or shim the top hinge to lift the latch side back into place.

EXTERIOR & WEATHERPROOFING · GUTTERS & DOWNSPOUTS

How often should I clean gutters in the Pacific Northwest?

Twice a year minimum - once in late fall after the leaves drop (mid-November) and once in spring (late March). Homes surrounded by Douglas fir, cedar, or big-leaf maple need a third mid-fall cleaning, typically late October. Skipping cleanings is the #1 cause of preventable siding and foundation damage we see.

INTERIOR REPAIRS · DRYWALL

How do I fix a drywall hole around a ceiling fixture?

For a hole smaller than the new fixture's canopy, no repair needed - the canopy covers it. For larger holes, cut a clean square around the damage, screw in a wood backer strip, patch with a drywall piece, tape the seams, and mud and sand in two coats. Ceilings need extra care because texture matching is the hardest part of the job.

APPLIANCES & FIXTURES · DISHWASHER & DISPOSAL

Can a remodel install a dishwasher in Washington?

Yes - a remodel can install a like-for-like dishwasher replacement: pull the old unit, disconnect the water supply and drain, slide the new unit in, and reconnect. What we can't do without a licensed electrician: hardwire a new circuit or upgrade the receptacle. Almost all replacements reuse the existing power connection, so this rarely comes up.

How long does a whole-home remodel actually take?

A cosmetic multi-room refresh runs 6 - 10 weeks. A kitchen + 2 baths + flooring is typically 12 - 20 weeks. Structural work or an addition pushes to 6 - 9 months including design and permitting. We commit exact dates in the contract with milestone payments tied to them.

Do you handle architectural drawings and permits?

Yes. For scopes without structural changes, we handle in-house drawings and permit submittal. For additions, ADUs, or load-bearing changes, we coordinate with a licensed architect or structural engineer and manage the full permit process end-to-end.

Can I phase the project?

Yes, and we recommend it for larger budgets. Common phasing: baths first (fastest ROI, least disruption), then kitchen, then flooring/paint, then exterior. Each phase is its own fixed-price contract, but the overall design is planned as one system so nothing is redone.

How much does full-home remodel cost?

Every full-home remodel project is priced with a written, line-item estimate - labor, materials, permits, and disposal broken out. Fixed price locked in a signed contract. Ranges depend on scope, materials, and finish level; consultations are free.

Do I need a design consultation first?

For anything beyond a straightforward install we start with a free onsite consultation. We walk your home, discuss scope and materials, and prepare a written estimate you can decide on with no obligation.

How do you handle change orders?

Any change to scope, materials, or finishes is documented in a written change order signed by both parties before that work proceeds. You always know the price before we start.

What areas do you cover for this?

From Marysville down through Snohomish County, across the Eastside to Bellevue, and over to Seattle - including Marysville, Everett, Mukilteo, Mill Creek, Lynnwood, Edmonds, Mountlake Terrace, Shoreline, Bothell, Kirkland, Bellevue, Redmond, Mercer Island, and Seattle. See the Service Areas page for the full list.

Is full-home remodel covered by your warranty?

Yes. We back all workmanship for 12 months on projects we perform directly. Materials and appliances are covered by their manufacturer warranty.

FAQs on Arcis Kitchen & Bath’s 10-Day Kitchen Remodels
What exactly is a 10-day kitchen remodel by Arcis Kitchen & Bath?

Our 10-day remodel is a highly streamlined process focused on efficiency and precision. We complete all essential updates to refresh and transform your kitchen within 10 days from the start of demolition.

What can I expect from a 10-day kitchen remodel?

You can expect a full cosmetic upgrade—cabinet refacing or replacement options, new countertops, updated fixtures, backsplash, flooring, and more. We elevate both the look and functionality of your kitchen in a fraction of the usual time.

How is Arcis Kitchen & Bath able to complete a remodel in just 10 days?

Through detailed pre-planning, a dedicated installation team, and well-coordinated processes, we streamline every step. All materials are ordered and confirmed before project start, allowing us to deliver a fast yet high-quality renovation.

Will the quality of work be compromised due to the fast timeline?

Not at all. Speed never comes at the expense of craftsmanship. Our efficient workflows and experienced installers ensure the same high-quality finish you’d expect from a traditional remodel—just faster.

Are there limitations on what can be done in a 10-day remodel?

A 10-day remodel is not a downgrade in quality. We use the same high-end products and finishes. The reason the timeline is short is because we avoid major construction—no moving walls, plumbing lines, or electrical layouts.

Structural changes or full redesigns require more time and city inspections, which extend the schedule.

What steps should I take to prepare for a 10-day remodel?

To keep the process smooth:

Clear out the kitchen and surrounding areas

Arrange temporary meal options

Finalize all design decisions, materials, and approvals before the start date

The more prepared you are, the more seamless the remodel.

Are permits required for a 10-day kitchen remodel with Arcis Kitchen & Bath?

Permits depend on the scope of work. Cosmetic “remove-and-replace” remodels may not require permits, but anything involving plumbing, electrical, or structural changes will. If needed, our team handles the entire permit process.

Can I make design changes during the 10-day remodel?

We strongly recommend finalizing all design decisions beforehand. Changes during installation may delay the project and extend it beyond the 10-day window. The design phase is critical to maintaining the schedule.

What happens if unexpected issues arise during the remodel?

Our experienced team is trained to handle surprises quickly and efficiently. We address any issues with minimal impact to the timeline whenever possible.

Contact us for a free consultation! We'll review your goals, evaluate your space, and guide you through the process to achieve a beautifully transformed kitchen in just 10 days.

FAQs on Arcis Kitchen & Bath’s Custom Kitchen Remodels
What is a custom kitchen remodel?

A custom kitchen remodel is a full renovation that gives you complete flexibility to change the layout, move walls, update plumbing and electrical, and design every element to fit your lifestyle and aesthetic. It’s a completely personalized transformation built around your vision.

What can I expect during a custom kitchen remodel?

Expect a detailed design process, expert craftsmanship, and a fully tailored renovation. This may include layout changes, removing or adding walls, relocating appliances, custom cabinetry, upgraded plumbing and electrical, high-end finishes, and premium materials—resulting in a truly unique kitchen.

How long does a custom kitchen remodel take?

Timelines vary depending on the level of customization and structural changes. Once designs are approved and materials are selected, we provide a clear project schedule outlining demolition, inspections, installation, and finishing stages.

Do custom kitchen remodels require permits?

Yes. Any project involving plumbing, electrical, structural changes, or layout modifications typically requires permits. Arcis Kitchen & Bath fully manages the permitting process with your local municipality to ensure compliance and smooth progress.

Can I change the design during the project?

Design changes are possible but may affect both the cost and timeline. Because custom remodels are more complex, we recommend finalizing all selections and structural decisions early in the design phase to prevent delays.

Will I need to move out during the remodel?

Most clients remain at home during the renovation, but you may need to adjust your daily routine. We set up protective barriers, limit dust, and maintain a clean work environment. For major structural changes, temporary adjustments may be needed.

What happens if unexpected issues are discovered?

During structural or older-home renovations, unforeseen conditions such as outdated wiring, plumbing issues, or hidden damage can arise. Our team addresses these issues promptly, communicates clearly, and updates you on any scope adjustments needed.

What’s the first step to starting a custom kitchen remodel?

Begin with a design consultation. We’ll review your ideas, explore layout possibilities, discuss materials and features, take measurements, and guide you through the planning phase so your custom kitchen is perfectly tailored to your home.

Our Story: Built on Advocacy, Crafted for Longevity

Arcadia was born from a desire for a fresh start, not just for us, but for the homeowners we serve. We saw a clear gap in the remodeling industry: homeowners were left navigating unreliable contractors, unclear expectations, and poor communication. After experiencing these challenges ourselves, we set out to build something different. We built a company where integrity, transparency, and service come first.

Founded in 2022 as a family-run business, Arcadia Renovations started by helping homeowners rebuild after unexpected losses. In the insurance restoration world, we earned our reputation the hard way: mastering scope writing, negotiating with carriers, and advocating until our clients received the full value they were owed. That work taught us how to manage complex projects under pressure, keep every trade accountable, and communicate clearly with families living through the most stressful moment their home has ever seen.

It also taught us something else. Of every room we rebuilt, none changed how a family felt about their home more than the bathroom. It's the first room you see each morning and the last one at night, and when it's done right, it changes the whole rhythm of the house. So we made a decision most contractors won't: instead of doing everything, we chose to do one thing exceptionally well. Today, Arcadia Renovations is focused on designing and building beautiful, timeless bathrooms across Metro Atlanta and North Georgia, while our reconstruction team continues to manage full-scope insurance claims from roof to foundation with the same precision that built our name.

Every project, whether a spa-worthy primary bath or a complete rebuild after a loss, is guided by the same promise: exceptional craftsmanship, clear communication, and a process you can actually trust.

Better mornings start here … We'd be honored to build yours.

The Faces Behind Arcadia

Arcadia is more than a company, it’s a family. Led by a team with over two decades of combined experience in construction, design, and project management, our work is built on shared values: trust, excellence, and care for the people we serve.

Each member of our team brings a personal commitment to doing things the right way - with honesty, respect, and attention to detail that our clients can feel in every finished space. We’re proud to be a family-built company with a culture rooted in accountability, creativity, and the simple belief that every home we touch should reflect pride, both yours and ours.

Ericksson Perez

Owner | Operations Manager

After nearly 14 years in corporate America, Ericksson Perez took a leap of faith into the remodeling world; a move that would ultimately inspire the creation of Arcadia. Guided by his extensive corporate background, he believes that true success is measured by impact rather than just profit. As a proud Latino, he is dedicated to serving his community and providing mentorship and opportunities for those around him, believing that a leader's duty is to lift others up and do the right thing even when no one is watching.

Beyond the business, Ericksson’s motivation is rooted in his family. Based in Acworth, he and his wife Carolyn are focused on building a legacy their daughter, Amara, can be proud of. Whether they are exploring the local foodie scene, attending fall festivals, or traveling to ensure Amara experiences a world of diversity and inclusion, family drives every decision he makes. Ericksson’s vision for Arcadia is simple: to redefine the standard of a general contractor and to be the elite remodeling and roofing firm that homeowners in North Georgia know they can implicitly trust.
